key.name: open-with-dialog
key.description: Show the application chooser when opening the last photo or video. When disabled, the default viewer is used.

key.name: jpeg-quality
key.description: Still-image JPEG quality from 70 to 100. Higher values keep more detail and use more storage.

key.name: photo-resolutions
key.description: Maps camera IDs to a requested JPEG size in WIDTHxHEIGHT form. Missing entries use the camera's full resolution.
